title: Dörthy Talk: Der Surftrip für Deine Ohren
author: Dörthe Eickelberg
description: In DÖRTHY TALK, presenter, writer and director Dörthe Eickelberg (CHICKS ON BOARDS, XENIUS, DIE NÄCHSTE WELLE IST FÜR DICH) dives head first into deep talks with surfers who have something to say. Topics are as vast as the ocean, the perspective is female. Based in Berlin and hence landlocked, Dörthe records her talks on her surftrips. The conversations are correspondingly diverse and multilingual. So don't be surprised if an episode in German or French follows an episode in English. DÖRTHY TALK is released every other Thursday, with more infos on IG @doerthe_eickelberg Logo: Naomi Fearn
